newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to head towards 4,690 then may ease.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to head towards 4,690 then may ease.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index will show a little more purpose in seeking a way through intermediate resistance at 4,670 and to 4,690 on Friday, technical analysts said.
But there is still a chance the market will become unhinged later in day, and unlike earlier in the week, market makers may not have the same opportunity to off-load shares, they added.
If buoyancy on Wall Street continues today, the threat of UK shares collapsing will be removed at least for the time being, they said.
By 0715 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 9.8 to 4,663.5.
Anxious moments leading to the expiration of June FTSE options and futures at 0930 GMT should then be followed by relatively calmer conditions.

But market bulls will be kept in check by fears concerning the budget on July 2. The bears may be overstating their case by bashing share prices down too far if the strength on Wall Street continues, analysts said. On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrials raced up 58.35 to 7,777.06.
On balance, the bears might manage to knock the FTSE back down to 4,630 later in the day and this has been a support level over the past two days.
The chances of the FTSE recovering from 4,630 appear slight because it still remains below its 10-day moving average and technically, this could be a depressant on the market, analysts said.
The FTSE's 10-day moving average is currently at 4,707.
